en-GB.name: Nurum: Zikirmatik Kuran Namaz
en-GB.subtitle: Ezan, Dua, Tesbih ve Hatim
en-GB.description:
Nurum is a simple, free daily spiritual routine app for dhikr, prayer and the Qur'an. No ads, no subscription, no account, no tracking.

DHIKR COUNTER
• Tap anywhere on the screen to count, with haptics and an optional click
• 200 supplications with Arabic text, transliteration and meaning
• Prayer tasbih, your own sets and the 99 Names of Allah
• Count from the home screen and lock screen widgets

PRAYER
• Diyanet prayer times for all 81 provinces of Türkiye, offline
• Prayer notifications, prayer tracking, missed prayers, qibla compass

THE QUR'AN
• Arabic text, transliteration and selectable translations
• Mushaf page layout, juz list, memorisation mode
• Search, recitation audio, bookmarks, notes and highlights
• Hatim progress and shared hatim with family and friends

Note: the app interface is in Turkish.

en-GB.name: Risale-i Nur: Lügat ve Ses
en-GB.subtitle: Sesli Risale, Osmanlıca Lügat
en-GB.description:
Read the Risale-i Nur collection by Bediüzzaman Said Nursi together with an in-context glossary and audio reading.

TAP A WORD, SEE ITS MEANING
Tap any word you don't know to see its meaning in that sentence, its root and its Ottoman spelling. A general Ottoman–Turkish dictionary is included as well.

LISTEN WORD BY WORD
Every section can be listened to while the current word is highlighted and the text follows along. Adjust the speed, keep listening with the screen locked, or download a book's audio to listen offline.

THE COMPLETE COLLECTION
Sözler, Mektubat, Lem'alar, Şuâlar, Mesnevî-i Nuriye, İşârâtü'l-İ'câz, Asâ-yı Mûsâ, Lâhikalar and more, with footnotes, translations of verses and hadiths and the printed edition's page numbers.

Note: the app interface is in Turkish.

en-GB.name: LinguaFlow: Hikâyeli İngilizce
en-GB.subtitle: Türkler için sesli İngilizce
en-GB.description:
LinguaFlow teaches English to Turkish speakers the way children learn: listen and understand first, then imitate, and finally build your own sentences.

LEARN THROUGH A STORY
• 104 audio episodes across levels A1, A2, B1 and B2
• Level checks at the end of each season
• Natural-speed, professional narration

LISTEN, IMITATE, SPEAK
• Shadowing with instant pronunciation scoring
• Dictation and sentence-building exercises
• Role play and free conversation with the story's characters

WORDS
• About 9,700 words from A1 to C2 with Turkish meanings and example sentences
• Irregular verbs (V1 · V2 · V3) in their own list

Note: the app interface is in Turkish.

tr.name: Ayet Ayet — Meal ve Tefsir
tr.subtitle: Her gün Kur'an, meal ve tefsir

en-GB.name: Ayet Ayet — Meal ve Tefsir
en-GB.subtitle: Günlük ayet ve Kur'an hatmi
en-GB.description:
Ayet Ayet helps you read the whole Qur'an, a little every day, together with its Turkish translation and commentary.

A DAILY READING
Each day you read your portion with the Arabic text, the Turkish translation and the commentary. You move forward in order, so no verse is skipped.

REMINDS YOU UNTIL YOU READ
A notification arrives at the time you choose, and repeats if you haven't finished that day's reading.

VERSE FEED, FREE READING AND HIGHLIGHTS
Short daily verses in a separate feed, open any surah freely, highlight the verses that move you and track your progress and streak.

PRAYER TIMES
Diyanet prayer times for your province and district.

Note: the app interface is in Turkish.

tr.name: Mihver — Günlük Düzen
tr.subtitle: Namaz, ilaç, su ve uyku takibi

en-GB.name: Mihver — Günlük Düzen
en-GB.subtitle: Zorunlu alarm ve günlük rutin
en-GB.description:
Mihver replaces a handful of separate apps with one daily routine: prayer times, medication reminders, water and sleep tracking, and more, all working around you.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Answer a few questions on first launch
2. Get suggested modules; add or remove what you like
3. Your three favourites stay on the Today screen

PRAYER
• Times calculated for your district's coordinates
• Track prayers and missed prayers, tahajjud window, adhan notifications
• Qibla, imsakiye, dhikr counter, the 99 Names, zakat calculator

FORCED ALARM
An alarm that won't stop until you answer the questions — for waking up for the dawn prayer.

HEALTH AND DAILY LIFE
Medication, water, sleep, blood pressure, weight, budget and tasks.

Note: the app interface is in Turkish.

tr.name: Şükür — Nimetleri Hatırla
tr.subtitle: Her gün şükür ve tefekkür
tr.description:
Şükür, Allah'ın sana her an verdiği ama farkına bile varmadığın nimetleri hatırlatan bir uygulamadır.

Gün içinde belirlediğin saatlerde kısa, vurucu bildirimler alırsın. Her bildirim seni bir an durdurup düşündürür: nefes almak, kalbinin atması, sevdiklerin, gördüklerin…

1875 özgün metin, 8 kategori:
• Beden: kalbin, nefesin, gözlerin
• Duyular: görme, duyma, tatma
• Doğa: su, toprak, güneş
• Gökyüzü: yıldızlar, ay, bulutlar
• Rızık: sofrandaki nimetler
• Sevdikler: aile, dostluk, bağ
• Zaman: anlar, mevsimler, ömür
• Gizli nimetler: farkında olmadıkların

• Günde 1–8 bildirim, istediğin saatte
• Kategoriye göre seçim
• İnternet gerekmez
• Tamamen ücretsiz, reklamsız

Bir an dur. Düşün. Şükret.

en-GB.name: Şükür — Nimetleri Hatırla
en-GB.subtitle: Şükret, tefekkür et, fark et
en-GB.description:
Şükür reminds you of the countless blessings you receive every moment but rarely notice.

At the times you choose, you receive short, striking notifications that make you pause and reflect: breathing, your heartbeat, the people you love, the things you see…

• 1,875 original texts in 8 categories
• 1–8 notifications a day, at the hours you pick
• Works offline
• Completely free, no ads

Note: the app interface is in Turkish.

en-GB.name: Çark — Karar ve Çekiliş
en-GB.subtitle: Şans çarkı ve isim çekme
en-GB.description:
Making a decision is sometimes the hardest part. Çark makes it for you, fairly.

DECISION WHEEL
Write your options, spin the wheel and go with the result. Start instantly with 7 ready-made templates, or build your own wheel with any number of options.

DRAWS AND RAFFLES
Enter the participants and spin. Each spin picks one person and removes them from the list, until everyone is drawn and you get the full ranking. Share the result in one tap.

Note: the app interface is in Turkish.

en-GB.name: Sakin Nokta: Sessiz Yerler
en-GB.subtitle: Ders çalışacak sessiz mekan
en-GB.description:
The city is loud. Sakin Nokta helps you find places where you can breathe.

Choose what you need — a quiet corner to work, a peaceful garden to rest, or a calm path to walk — and see nearby places ranked by calmness.

• Calmness score and the quietest hours for every place
• Over 1,800 parks, libraries, botanical gardens, seafronts, bookshops and museums in Türkiye and Europe
• Live search via OpenStreetMap to expand to any area
• Save your own quiet spots with notes

Note: the app interface is in Turkish.

en-GB.name: Rota Planlayıcı: Gezi Planı
en-GB.subtitle: Gezilecek yerler ve gün planı
en-GB.description:
Planning which place to visit on which day can take hours. Rota Planlayıcı brings it down to a few minutes.

1. Choose a country and city
2. Enter where you're staying and for how many days
3. Swipe through the sights: right to keep, left to skip
4. Your daily route is built automatically

• Smart distribution by location, visit time and priority
• Pace and transport options
• 35 countries, 203 cities
• Open each day's route in Google Maps with one tap

Note: the app interface is in Turkish.

tr.name: Tally: Veresiye Defteri
tr.subtitle: Esnaf için borç alacak takibi
tr.description:
Tally, küçük esnaf için dijital veresiye defteridir: bakkal, fırın, kasap, mahalle marketi. Müşterinin borcunu yaz, ödemeyi kaydet, WhatsApp'tan nazik bir hatırlatma gönder; hepsi cebinde.

ÖZELLİKLER
• Borç ve ödemeyi saniyeler içinde ekle: ad, tutar, tamam
• Her müşterinin bakiyesi kendiliğinden hesaplanır
• WhatsApp hatırlatması: bakiyeyle birlikte tek dokunuşla
• Hesap dökümünü müşterinle paylaş
• Uygulama kilidi: Face ID / parmak izi
• CSV dışa aktarma, yedekleme ve geri yükleme

VERİN SENDE KALIR
İnternet gerekmez, hesap yok, bulut yok. Tüm kayıtlar yalnızca cihazında.

Kâğıt defteri kaldır; veresiye defterin artık cebinde.
tr.promotionalText: Kâğıt veresiye defterini kaldır: müşteri borcunu yaz, ödemeyi kaydet, WhatsApp'tan hatırlat. İnternetsiz, hesapsız, tamamen cihazında.

tr.name: Dodge Arena: Toplardan Kaç
tr.subtitle: Refleks ve hayatta kalma oyunu
tr.description:
Arenada hayatta kal. Her şeyden kaç.

Dodge Arena, sonsuz bir hayatta kalma oyunudur. Seni takip eden avcı toplardan, hızla çoğalan düşmanlardan ve daralan arenadan kurtulmaya çalış.

NASIL OYNANIR
Parmağını sürükle ya da dokun, oyuncunu hareket ettir. Toplar sana çarpmadan olabildiğince uzun süre hayatta kal.

GÜÇLENDİRMELER
• Kalkan: hasar koruması
• Can: ekstra yaşam hakkı
• Dondur: tüm topları durdur
• Savur: yakındaki topları it
• Kötü güçlendirmelerden (ateş, hız, alan) kaç!

SEVİYE SİSTEMİ
Her seviyede toplar hızlanır, çoğalır ve arena küçülür. 10. seviyeye ulaşabilir misin?

ÖZELLİKLER
• Selfie modunda kendi yüzünle oyna
• Neon görsel efektler ve top izleri
• Ağır çekim, patlama efektleri, ekran sarsıntısı
• Reklamsız, ücretsiz, tamamen internetsiz

en-GB.name: Dodge Arena: Toplardan Kaç
en-GB.subtitle: Dodge. Survive. Repeat.
en-GB.description:
Survive the arena. Dodge everything.

Dodge Arena is an endless survival game. Escape the hunter balls chasing you, the fast-multiplying enemies and the shrinking arena.

• Drag or tap to move
• Power-ups: shield, extra life, freeze, push — and bad ones to avoid
• Every level is faster, busier and smaller. Can you reach level 10?
• Play with your own face in selfie mode
• Neon effects, bullet time, particles
• No ads, free, fully offline

tr.name: Hocaya Sor: Dini Soru Cevap
tr.subtitle: Fetva, fıkıh ve İslami rehber
tr.description:
Dini sorularınızı İslam âlimlerine sorun, güvenilir cevaplar alın.

Hocaya Sor; fıkıh, ibadet, Kur'an ve tefsir, hadis ve sünnet, akaid ve güncel dini meseleler hakkında uzman hocalara soru sorabildiğiniz ücretsiz bir dini danışmanlık uygulamasıdır.

NASIL ÇALIŞIR?
Sorunuzu yazın ve gönderin. Uzman hocalarımız sorunuzu inceler ve en kısa sürede ayrıntılı cevap yazar. Cevap hazır olduğunda bildirim alırsınız.

KONU KATEGORİLERİ
• Fıkıh ve ibadet
• Kur'an ve tefsir
• Hadis ve sünnet
• Akaid ve inanç
• Helal ve haram
• Aile ve nikâh
• Güncel dini meseleler

Tamamen ücretsizdir. Abonelik veya ödeme yoktur.

en-GB.name: Hocaya Sor: Dini Soru Cevap
en-GB.subtitle: İslam âlimine sorunu sor
en-GB.description:
Ask your religious questions to Islamic scholars and receive reliable answers.

Hocaya Sor is a free religious guidance app where you can ask expert scholars about fiqh, worship, the Qur'an and tafsir, hadith and sunnah, creed and current religious matters.

Write and send your question; a scholar reviews it and writes a detailed answer, and you get a notification when it's ready. Completely free, no subscription.

Note: the app interface is in Turkish.
